int-value.provenance: inferred (rules binding_sources NSControl): two-way bind:int-value through the control's action, value read back. NSControl target-action: the control sends its action after a user change (click, drag, keyboard; continuously while tracking when `continuous`); the value is read back. Programmatic sets and native clamping (min/max changes) send nothing. Probe on <button>: round trip exact, the programmatic set did not emit action; delivery seen

state.provenance: two-way bind:state for checkboxes (button-type switch): the action fires after a user click toggled the state and carries no value, so the state is read back; setting state never sends the action

double-value.provenance: two-way bind:double-value; continuous sliders send the action while dragging (no value: read back); programmatic sets never send it

double-value.provenance: inferred (rules binding_sources NSTextField): two-way bind:double-value through the NSControlTextDidChangeNotification notification, value read back. NSControlTextDidChangeNotification is posted by the field editor for every user edit of the text (NSControl.h); a value prop read in the handler reflects the edit. Programmatic sets and native normalization (formatters) post nothing. Probe on <text-field>: round trip exact, the programmatic set did not emit control-text-did-change; delivery seen
